title: Inventory Status Display
content: Build inventory status display system. Stock indicators: "In Stock" (green), "Low Stock" (orange with "Only X left"), "Out of Stock" (red). Progress bar: visual stock level (green > 50%, yellow 20-50%, red < 20%). Restock date: "Back in stock: Est. Jan 15" when available. Location-based: "Available at 3 nearby stores". Pre-order option: show when out of stock with expected date. Size-specific: show stock per size in size selector.

variants.simple: Create inventory status indicators showing stock levels.
variants.detailed: Build inventory status display system. Stock indicators: "In Stock" (green), "Low Stock" (orange with "Only X left"), "Out of Stock" (red). Progress bar: visual stock level (green > 50%, yellow 20-50%, red < 20%). Restock date: "Back in stock: Est. Jan 15" when available. Location-based: "Available at 3 nearby stores". Pre-order option: show when out of stock with expected date. Size-specific: show stock per size in size selector.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive inventory status display system with multiple display modes. Stock level indicator component: accepts current stock and threshold props. Display variants based on level: In Stock (stock > lowThreshold): text-green-600 with Check icon, optionally hide if always in stock; Low Stock (stock > 0 && stock <= lowThreshold): text-orange-500 with AlertTriangle icon, "Only X left in stock" or "Selling fast - only X left" for urgency; Out of Stock (stock === 0): text-red-600 with X icon, "Out of Stock" or "Sold Out". Visual progress bar: h-2 rounded-full bg-gray-200, inner bar with dynamic width (stock/maxStock * 100%), color transition (bg-green-500 > 50%, bg-yellow-500 20-50%, bg-red-500 < 20%). Numeric display option: "42 available" or "42/100 in stock" for B2B. Restock information: when out of stock, show estimated restock date if available ("Expected back: January 15, 2024"), notify button to subscribe for restock alerts. Pre-order availability: when out of stock but pre-order enabled, show "Pre-order now - Ships by Feb 1" with different button styling. Location-based stock: for omnichannel, "Available at 3 nearby stores" link opening store selector, "Check store availability" button, show stock level per location. Size/variant specific: in size selector, each option shows stock indicator (dot: green/orange/red or "2 left"), disabled styling for out-of-stock variants with strikethrough or grayed appearance. Cart/checkout stock warnings: "Hurry! Only 2 left and 5 people have this in their cart" social proof, real-time stock validation before checkout. Stock alerts: modal or form for email notification signup when back in stock. Reserved stock: "Reserved for 10 minutes" when item added to cart, countdown timer optional. Backorder: "Available on backorder - Ships in 2-3 weeks" option when stock is 0 but backorder allowed. B2B enhancements: show exact quantities, bulk availability, lead times for larger orders. Accessibility: stock status announced with aria-live for dynamic updates, color not sole indicator (always include text/icon).
